mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", listener_id AS "listenerId", provider_id AS "providerId", listener_key AS "listenerKey", event_type_id AS "eventTypeId", ability_id AS "abilityId", max_triggers_per_event AS "maxTriggersPerEvent", chain_limit_key AS "chainLimitKey", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.provider_listeners WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND listener_id = #{listenerId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.provider_listeners (game_id, listener_id, provider_id, listener_key, event_type_id, ability_id, max_triggers_per_event, chain_limit_key, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{listenerId}, #{providerId}, #{listenerKey}, #{eventTypeId}, #{abilityId}, #{maxTriggersPerEvent}, #{chainLimitKey}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, listener_id) DO UPDATE SET provider_id = EXCLUDED.provider_id, listener_key = EXCLUDED.listener_key, event_type_id = EXCLUDED.event_type_id, ability_id = EXCLUDED.ability_id, max_triggers_per_event = EXCLUDED.max_triggers_per_event, chain_limit_key = EXCLUDED.chain_limit_key, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", listener_id AS "listenerId", provider_id AS "providerId", listener_key AS "listenerKey", event_type_id AS "eventTypeId", ability_id AS "abilityId", max_triggers_per_event AS "maxTriggersPerEvent", chain_limit_key AS "chainLimitKey", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.provider_listeners WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, listener_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.provider_listeners_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, listener_id, provider_id, listener_key, event_type_id, ability_id, max_triggers_per_event, chain_limit_key ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, listener_id, provider_id, listener_key, event_type_id, ability_id, max_triggers_per_event, chain_limit_key FROM public.provider_listeners WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, listener_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, provider_id = EXCLUDED.provider_id, listener_key = EXCLUDED.listener_key, event_type_id = EXCLUDED.event_type_id, ability_id = EXCLUDED.ability_id, max_triggers_per_event = EXCLUDED.max_triggers_per_event, chain_limit_key = EXCLUDED.chain_limit_key
